name: contact-merge
description: Merge two contacts into one, consolidating channel identities and auth overrides using golden-record survivorship rules. Use dry_run: true to preview the result before committing. Run dry_run: false only when the principal confirmed the merge, or when a dedup review task says the decision is yours. It cannot change the principal's own addresses.
